reviews.text: When they periodically have their sales of 20 to 30% off it's a great place to go.
Amazing friendly staff, good variety and self wash!
Great selection of pet food and products.  Good parking and helpful staff
Everything you need ....you want....for your little and not so little precious ones .....and most importantly everything THEY
We picked up some cat food that's been discontinued and everyone was very friendly.

I had the BEST experience at this store. Stephanie the manager went way beyond the call of duty to help me with an item that I had purchased. She is by far the most attentive and thoughtful retail manager I've come in contact with. It definitely makes me want to buy my pet supplies and food here instead of Chewy or Amazon.

I went to Centinela Feed & Pet Supplies. The store has some good selection of products, but the service could have been better. The staff was busy and it took a while to get help. A few improvements could have made the experience better.
Walking distance helps... Lately sale items have been flying off the shelf. Good and bad ... I seem to be a step behind getting there in time for the essentials.
Friendly helpful staff
I shop here for my cats and dogs. Great high quality pet food and they are always so friendly and very helpful.
Friendliest workers and best place to shop for my puppy's toys and treats!

You can self serve wash your doggy here. They have everything you need. Shampoo, conditioner, aprons, slip leash, towels and blow dryers. The sinks and faucets they have work great too. Make sure too get the stamp car for the 5 washes for 70 bucks too.
They have a great selection of everything food related for dogs. The staff are really friendly and helpful and greet you as you enter asking how they can help and if they can help you find anything.
I love the bath your pooch, self wash. Worth the $70 for 5 washes.
Big pet shop.   Nice people

I love shopping at Centinela Pet Store! The staff is always friendly, knowledgeable, and ready to help with any questions I have about my pets. They have a great selection of high-quality food, treats, and toys—plus lots of specialty items you can’t always find elsewhere. The store is clean, well-organized, and it’s clear they genuinely care about animals. Highly recommend for any pet parent looking for a reliable, locally owned pet store!
Very nice, excellent dedicated staff

I called this store to inquire about Bermuda Hay and various products for my tortoise.  The young lady who answered the phone (unusual name), was upbeat, and extremely helpful, smart  and kind.  Centinela F&P didn't have the product I needed and she was great in suggesting other sources when asked.  Good and caring customer service is so rare these days and she gave great suggestions on how to solve my problem.  This young lady, provided she keeps it up, will go far!  Thanks for hiring such a person at Centinela Feed and Pet supplies.  She made me think well of this business and I will shop here in the future.
Employees go above and beyond. Not only helping however they can in store, but also remembering pets names that come in.
Not a lot of parking. But usually clean and calm.
They have great sales.And I like to support local business
Pricey. Extensive inventory. Convenient.
Great Pet Store! They have everything your pet could possibly need. Employees are wonderfully helpful and friendly. Shout out to manager Savannah who is fabulous!

I go there to get my dog a shower It's a self service  thing that provides all the necessary products to achieve the most economical and most propitious way to clean up your dog  the employees are most courteous and promptly take care of your needs for under $20.00 dollars is the best deal around
Excellent staff,

Love them! They are super knowledgeable on all products & so friendly. My favorite pet store.

Also there products are not just overly advertised pet food & supplies but quality products.

This past month I have been to this location 3 times. The first 2 times I found what I needed and found the cash register unmanned. I waited and waited and nobody came, so I left! Today I went in for a sale on my cat’s food. There was a cashier this time but she was very rude and unprofessional. I was just trying to get clarity regarding the sale being applied to my purchase. She mistakenly took this as me becoming upset and became very frustrated with me. She made several snarky comments to me about “not wanting to ruffle my feathers”.  As I was entering my payment she started complaining to the security guard about how she couldn’t wait to leave. Right in front of me. I get it, you work at a pet store but seriously, if you’re that miserable find something else. I shouldn’t be a part of your bad day as a paying customer. The location on Bundy leads a masterclass in customer service every single visit. I’m never going back to the Pico location.

If you lose your “punch card” for the dog washes they “can’t do anything about it”. 1 star for their archaic system which relies on you keeping tabs on a flimsy business card sized piece of paper. Everything in the store is also over priced by 20-30%.

They are more focused on making money than anything else.

The staff is beyond helpful. My cat has subsided her stomach issues in lieu of their recommendations. In the 12 years I've enjoyed my cat's company, never has she appeared this tranquil. One thousand stars 🙏🏼✨ …

Savana was very patient and knowledgeable about dog and cat products which was great because instead of leaving my supplements for only my dog I caved and bought food and toys for my cat as well. Store was very organized and clean, bathrooms available and not too busy at 11am
Super convenient. Friendly staff. Has a diy dog wash station that my Doberman mix is only mildly afraid of 🤣. Bonus: they carry chicken feed! …
Nice stock of just about anything (food, dog housing, dog beds, and more) you will need for your pets.
A bit pricey but good service
I'm A Guard There
Helpful staff great for my pups needs
